Class OpenResult

java.lang.Object
org.roux.session.OpenResult
public final class OpenResult extends Object
The OpenResult is the outcome of opening a region. NEW is 0, and it means an empty region. RESTORED is 1, and it means stored pages were read back. REFUSED is 2, and it means the open stopped. A refused result carries a reason string. A null reason is stored as an empty string. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#OpenResult roux-v1.md

  • Constructor Details

    • OpenResult

      private OpenResult(int kind, int messageCount, UUID regionUuid, String reason)
      The constructor stores the kind, the message count, the region id, and the reason. A null reason is stored as an empty string.
      Parameters:
      kind - The kind is NEW, RESTORED, or REFUSED.
      messageCount - The count is the number of indexed messages.
      regionUuid - The id is the region identifier, or null.
      reason - The reason is the refusal text, or an empty string.

  • Method Details

    • neu

      public static OpenResult neu(UUID regionUuid)
      The method builds a new-region result. The kind is NEW. The message count is 0.
      Parameters:
      regionUuid - The id is the identifier of the new region.
      Returns:
      The result is a new empty region.

    • restored

      public static OpenResult restored(int messageCount, UUID regionUuid)
      The method builds a restored-region result. The kind is RESTORED.
      Parameters:
      messageCount - The count is the number of indexed messages.
      regionUuid - The id is the identifier of the restored region.
      Returns:
      The result is a restored region.

    • refused

      public static OpenResult refused(String reason)
      The method builds a refused result. The kind is REFUSED. The region id is null.
      Parameters:
      reason - The reason is the text that says why the open stopped.
      Returns:
      The result is a refusal.
